newsitem.title: JAPAN: RTRS-India awards Suez Blend, Qua Iboe in tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-India awards Suez Blend, Qua Iboe in tender - traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is believed to have awarded four Egyptian Suez Blend cargoes and three Nigerian Qua Iboe cargoes in its tender to buy May-loading crude oil, industry sources said on Friday.
Two Suez Blend cargoes were believed to have been awarded to a Japanese trading company at even to the official selling price and a U.S. oil company at a premium of three cents.
The awards could not be immediately confirmed with the successful bidders.
Traders were divided about the source of the two remaining cargoes.
Some market participants said the remaining two cargoes were awarded to a Swiss- based trader at dated Brent minus $2.50.
Other industry sources said the trader was only awarded one cargo and that a European major sold a cargo at dated Brent minus $2.70.

Three very large crude carriers (VLCCs) of Qua Iboe were also awarded in the tender -- two to the Swiss-based trader and one to a U.S. major -- but the terms of the deal were not immediately available.
Four offers of Dubai were believed to have been made for IOC's May buying tender, but most traders were not surprised to hear that none had been taken up.
Many market participants had expected India's interest in the sour crude to be dampened because of IOC's February deal to buy 3.6 million barrels of Iraqi crude over 90 days.
